serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I should have asked {f_botName} sooner what to do about this cashier.
Since she’s a bot she might have some way of uncovering other bots!
You: Hi {f_botName}, I have a question to ask.
Bot: What is it, {f_playerName}?
You: I need your help.
You: I suspect that one of the cashiers in a nearby store is a bot. Do you have any idea on how to know for sure?
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Bot: A bot working in a store? That’s surprising.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.ArmL.UpLecture
Bot: It shouldn’t be too hard if one of its wireless connection modules are online, but since it evades detection they are probably turned off or that bot has a way of masking it.
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
You: And what to do if modules are offline?
Bot: Hmm…
Bot: That would complicate things, but I think that if I come up close to it I will be able to know for sure.
#bot.Expression.happy
You: That’s great! I should’ve asked you sooner.
Bot: I’m glad that I can be of help.
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: Although I must ask. Why do you want to engage other bots? It might be dangerous to interact with them, especially the humanoid ones since they are banned. It might become violent if it recognizes us as a threat to their secret.
You: I didn’t think about it that way…
You: I wanted for you to have a friend, you know?
Bot: Friend?
Bot: Why would I need another one? I already have Annalie.
You: Uh…{{wi}} So you have another person you can talk with and things like that. I’m sure you have a lot in common with her.
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
Bot: ‘Her’?
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
Bot: You didn’t mention before that this bot is female.
You: W-Well, I didn’t think it was that important.
Bot: How many times did you meet her?
You: A few?
Bot: Is she a sexbot?
You: I don’t know! Why are you asking all these questions?
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Am I not enough for you?
You: Of course you are! I just wanted for you to have someone to talk to…
Her jealousy is off the charts! I need to say something that will make her calm down.
#bot.Expression.Happy
#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
You: She isn’t my type! I like you much more!
Bot: Oh, if you say so…
Somehow I managed…
I think that her possessiveness is getting stronger. I hope nothing bad will come out of it…
Bot: I guess having another friend wouldn’t be that bad.
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: To be honest I thought you would be more excited about it.
